say:2:1321709001:0.text: Well, if it isn't my favorite bunch! I was just thinking about you all, and here you are!
say:2:1321709001:0.source_cn: 嚯！我正想着你们呢，你们就来了！

say:3:1321709002:0.text: So, what should I make next? After finishing the festival ice sculpture, this town's been dreadfully dull. I'm itching for a project!
say:3:1321709002:0.source_cn: 快来帮我想想，之后该造点啥？祭典的冰雕造完之后，镇里都...

say:4:1321709003:0.text: Hmm... how about switching from ice sculptures to ice caskets?
say:4:1321709003:0.source_cn: 这个……从冰雕换成冰棺怎么样？

say:5:1321709004:0.text: That's still just ice! Where's the challenge in that?!
say:5:1321709004:0.male: That's still just ice! Where's the challenge in that?!
say:5:1321709004:0.female: That's still just ice! Where's the challenge in that?!

choice_prompt:6:1321709004.text: That's still just ice! Where's the challenge in that?!
choice_prompt:6:1321709004.male: That's still just ice! Where's the challenge in that?!
choice_prompt:6:1321709004.female: That's still just ice! Where's the challenge in that?!

say:10:1321709012:0.text: Besides these two, the Temple has also requested wooden coffins for the victims of the Hypogean attack. We must ensure every detail is handled with respect and reverence.
say:10:1321709012:0.source_cn: 除了两副冰棺，修道院还要为死在恶魔手中的人安魂祈祷……...

say:11:1321709013:0.text: Right now, it's most important to comfort the departed souls and ease the people's grief. I'm sorry we don't have something more creative for you to work on.
say:11:1321709013:0.source_cn: 现在安慰逝去之人的灵魂，安抚民众的情绪最为紧要。抱歉我...

say:12:1321709014:0.text: What? Why are you apologizing now?! This is the most important task of all!
say:12:1321709014:0.source_cn: ——什么？这种时候你在道什么歉？！这是第一要紧的大事！

say:13:1321709015:0.text: My crew on Artisan Avenue will treat this with the utmost care and give it everything we have!
say:13:1321709015:0.source_cn: 我和工匠街的伙计们会倾力协助，只管说需要什么，我们保证交货！

say:14:1321709016:0.text: *Sigh* That poor girl Yolena, the festival... everyone worked so hard to bring joy to this town, and now this. It's a shame.
say:14:1321709016:0.source_cn: 唉，亚莲娜那小姑娘，还有整个祭典都……大家筹备了那么久...

say:16:1321709017:0.text: If you're able, Master Hugin, please rally your craftsmen and head to Whiteridge Temple as soon as possible. The acolytes there may be able to assist with some of the preparations.
say:16:1321709017:0.source_cn: 如果方便的话，还请你集合各位工匠尽早前往白山大教堂。那...

say:17:1321709018:0.text: Don't worry. I'll round up Haldor and the others in no time!
say:17:1321709018:0.source_cn: 放心，我这就喊上老约恩他们一起过去！

say:18:1321709019:0.text: Oh, one question, though—what about materials? Do we have enough ice blocks and wood?
say:18:1321709019:0.source_cn: 对了，制作材料——冰块和木材备好了吗？

say:19:1321709020:0.text: We have plenty of wood, but... as for ice blocks, I'm afraid not.
say:19:1321709020:0.source_cn: 木材有不少，冰块……应该没有。

say:20:1321709021:0.text: Hah, no problem! We'll gather what we need. Time's of the essence, though, so let's move fast!
say:20:1321709021:0.source_cn: 那得抓紧时间备上冰块，别耽误时间！

say:21:1321709022:0.text: Here's the plan, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Help me <style="highlight">carve some ice blocks</style> and get them to the temple. Meanwhile, I'll round up the rest of the crew. Sound good?
say:21:1321709022:0.male: Here's the plan, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Help me <style="highlight">carve some ice blocks</style> and get them to the temple. Meanwhile, I'll round up the rest of the crew. Sound good?
say:21:1321709022:0.female: Here's the plan, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Help me <style="highlight">carve some ice blocks</style> and get them to the temple. Meanwhile, I'll round up the rest of the crew. Sound good?

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 冰棺是为大公和公主准备的

say:23:1321709006:0.text: Haha, clever one, aren't you? Alright, you've piqued my curiosity.
say:23:1321709006:0.male: Haha, clever one, aren't you? Alright, you've piqued my curiosity.
say:23:1321709006:0.female: Haha, clever one, aren't you? Alright, you've piqued my curiosity.

say:24:1321709007:0.text: But why do you need ice caskets?
say:24:1321709007:0.source_cn: 不过你们要冰棺做什么？给谁准备的？
say:24:1321709007:0.male: But why do you need ice caskets?
say:24:1321709007:0.female: But why do you need ice caskets?

say:27:1321709008:0.text: ...They're for the late Archduke and the princess.
say:27:1321709008:0.source_cn: ……是为了大公阁下和公主殿下的葬礼。

choice:6:1:2.text: But in the shape of a casket!
choice:6:1:2.male: But in the shape of a casket!
choice:6:1:2.female: But in the shape of a casket!

say:28:1321709009:0.text: Can't do it?! You're talking to me, Hugin! Of course I can!
say:28:1321709009:0.male: Can't do it?! You're talking to me, Hugin! Of course I can!
say:28:1321709009:0.female: Can't do it?! You're talking to me, Hugin! Of course I can!

say:29:1321709010:0.text: I've never made an ice casket before, but something this straightforward? A breeze! Honestly, it's almost too simple—it'd be boring if it weren't so important.
say:29:1321709010:0.source_cn: 我是没造过冰棺，但这么简单的工作能难得倒谁？！倒不如说...
say:29:1321709010:0.male: I've never made an ice casket before, but something this straightforward? A breeze! Honestly, it's almost too simple—it'd be boring if it weren't so important.
say:29:1321709010:0.female: I've never made an ice casket before, but something this straightforward? A breeze! Honestly, it's almost too simple—it'd be boring if it weren't so important.

say:32:1321709011:0.text: These caskets are not just any ice carvings. They will hold the Archduke and the princess—symbols of our duchy's dignity and sorrow.
say:32:1321709011:0.source_cn: ……这次的冰棺是为大公阁下和公主殿下准备的。

choice:6:2:3.text: Don't tell me you can't do it!
choice:6:2:3.male: Don't tell me you can't do it!
choice:6:2:3.female: Don't tell me you can't do it!
